findings.passage: Let me tell you something. Our system has been broke, but it was even more broke this year, not so much because of who won or who lost, but it was broke because, bless its heart, the voter suppression idea went right out the door.
findings.note: Words from his House floor speech in favour of House Bill 531 (2021 election bill that added an ID number requirement for absentee ballot applications), as played and transcribed in a Georgia Public Broadcasting podcast dated 2021-03-05. The report says the speech was earlier that week, so the exact day is not stated. In it he says the election system was already broken and was worse in 2020.
